Shows Swallow Bay and Condesa Bay of Santa Inés Island and adjacent portions of the Strait of Magellan. Depths shown by soundings. Prime meridian: Cádiz. Oriented with north toward the lower right. Watermark: Strasburg fleur-de-lis. Pen-and-ink and watercolor. Mounted on cloth backing. Includes index and note. Maggs number annotated in pencil in lower right margin: 175.
